description: Every update gets GitHub's auto-merge through platform-automerge and is merged once a code owner in .github/CODEOWNERS approves it. The image is built only on pull requests that touch it, so no check is required by the ruleset; an update to the image is approved once its build on the pull request has passed

packageRules.description: The base image is pulled by a tag that keeps moving (eclipse-temurin:11-jre is rebuilt for every Java 11 patch), so a checkout does not say which image a build used. Pinning the digest states it in the Dockerfile and lets Renovate follow each rebuild of the tag, which the weekly release then publishes
